typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		ITERATION as string,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		MISC_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT                   CLCL_ID, 	ROOT_CLCL_ID,  	CCERT_LEAD_TYPE, 	SC_SCHEME, 	SC_SUBSCHEME,                   CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), MARKET) AS MARKET, 	ITERATION, 	CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG,                   MISC_DATA FROM [TRK].[STG_CLAIM_ITERATION]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSourceCVIWSSTGCLAIMITERATION
OLEDBSourceCVIWSSTGCLAIMITERATION sink(input(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		ITERATION as string,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		MISC_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE,
		SC_SCHEME,
		SC_SUBSCHEME,
		MARKET,
		ITERATION,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG,
		CLCL_ID,
		MISC_DATA)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestinationAGPBIDRSTGCLAIM
